atomic_facts.fact: Do Kwon's full legal name is Kwon Do-hyung.
Do Kwon is the co-founder of Terraform Labs.
Do Kwon is the former CEO of Terraform Labs.
Do Kwon was sentenced to 15 years in prison in December 2025.
The sentence was imposed by US District Judge Paul Engelmayer at a hearing in New York.
As of 2026-10-01, Do Kwon is serving a 15-year sentence in a US federal prison.
Do Kwon is not detained by Montenegrin authorities; he was extradited from Montenegro to the US.
